methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional community-wide AI education infrastructure beyond elite institutions, creating conditions for distributed capability building if implementation reaches beyond university walls into neighborhoods and small businesses.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Ed2go's platform partnership with RC-RV signals shallow, vendor-delivered training rather than deep capability building—distributing access geographically but not creating the technical depth needed for innovation in transition economies.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M AI data center infrastructure investment in Henrico concentrates physical AI capability in metro Richmond, creating 200 jobs but signaling capital flowing to existing hubs rather than distributing computational resources to underserved regions.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Young workers feeling 'AI pressure' without corresponding skill-building infrastructure signals anxiety without capability development—neither depth nor broad distribution materializing, just displacement concern among entry-level workforce.

signals.title: Roanoke College president: Virginia’s future workforce depends on fixing the path from college to career - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College president's focus on fixing college-to-career pathways addresses the infrastructure needed for distributed deep capability, though success depends on whether solutions emphasize peer learning networks or continue relying on centralized institutional gatekeeping.
